title: Identification of the supplied ringed tensor chain with the specified completion chain
statement: For a prime l, a finite l-adic coefficient field E, a scheme X, a supplied RingedModels presentation d and arbitrary completed-coefficient complexes P,Q, the component d.tensor(X).chain(P,Q) equals ConstructibleTensorModel.tensorCompletionChain(P,Q). The equality is of complete strict Roos chain maps, including the shifted coordinate. No K-flatness or invertibility hypothesis is imposed.

source.place: Tags 07A4, 06YS and 0941; representative normalization step of lem-sf-tensor-reduction-augmentation

proof.text: Apply ringedTensorChain_eq_strictAugmentation to the supplied presentation. Evaluate the resulting transformation equality at P,Q. StrictTensorAugmentation.map_app identifies that component with IntegralAmbient.tensorOperationUnit. tensorCompletionChain_app identifies the specified completion chain with tensorCompletionUnitMap, whose definition is exactly the same operation unit. Thus the two cochain maps are equal, including both Roos coordinates.

lean.statement:
theorem ringedTensorChain_eq_tensorCompletionChain (X : Scheme.{u})
    (d : IntegralSystemRealization.RingedModels l E)
    (P Q : CochainComplex (integralTowerModules l E X) ℤ) :
    (d.tensor X).chain.app (P, Q) =
      (ConstructibleTensorModel.tensorCompletionChain l E X).app (P, Q)
